summary: Knightscope, Inc. filed an 8-K/A to amend its initial March 3, 2026 report regarding the acquisition of all outstanding membership interests of Event Risk, LLC from seller Eric Rose on February 27, 2026. The filing provides audited financial statements of Event Risk and unaudited pro forma combined financials as required by Items 9.01(a) and (b). No purchase price, consideration, or board recommendation details are disclosed. The transaction closed on the signing date. Watch for integration risks and the impact on Knightscope's balance sheet and Nasdaq-listed equity.
